title: The Funnel Math Sheet: How Many Emails for One Signed Client
description: Work out how many cold emails you need for one signed client, using our real campaign numbers: 162,073 emails, 31 demos, 6 annual contracts.
lead: This is the funnel math sheet from the reel. It shows how many emails it took us to sign one client in a real campaign, and how to work out the same number for your business.
insider: This sheet comes from our campaign for a construction software company. The reply rate was below the 2026 average, and we still booked **31 qualified demos and 6 annual contracts**, because we aimed at real decision makers. Getting those numbers right for your business is the first thing we plan with every client.

blocks.text: That's roughly **27,000 emails per signed client** for this company. Your number will be different. The point is to know yours before you start.

items: Pick your monthly goal: how many new clients you want.
Estimate your demo-to-client rate. If you don't know it, start with 1 in 5.
Estimate emails per demo. Start with a careful guess, then replace it with your real number after the first 2 weeks.
Multiply: clients × demos per client × emails per demo = emails you need per month.

blocks.label: Funnel prompt
blocks.text:
My goal: [number] new clients per month.
My average deal size: $[amount].
My demo-to-client rate: [1 in X].
Emails needed per demo (guess for now): [number].

Calculate: demos needed per month, emails needed per month and per day (22 working days), and the revenue if I hit the goal. Then tell me which number I should test first to lower the cost per client. Show it as a table.

blocks.label: The real scoreboard
blocks.text: Reply rate is not the scoreboard. Booked calls and signed contracts are. 100 replies from the wrong people = $0.

resources.name: Instantly benchmarks
resources.note: Source of the 3.43% average reply rate mentioned in the reel

faq.q: Why so many emails per client?
faq.a: This campaign sold annual software contracts to construction companies, a careful buyer. Faster sales cycles usually need fewer emails.
Better targeting. Emailing the right decision makers raises demos per email more than any copy trick.
